title: Vikasa
teaser: Product design and mechanical engineering for the next generation of desktop 3D printing.
headline: Product design work in desktop fabrication, where hardware decisions shaped the user’s whole making workflow.
challenge: The Replicator ecosystem needed mechanical and product design decisions that could support a high-volume prosumer 3D printing market.
outcome: Ali contributed product design and mechanical engineering judgment to a hardware and software ecosystem for next-generation desktop 3D printing.
bullets: Worked on product design and mechanical engineering for desktop 3D printing hardware.
Connected fabrication constraints with the user experience of a prosumer hardware ecosystem.
Built early product instincts around physical systems, software adjacency, and high-volume hardware expectations.
